description: Per-field options for a fuzzy term-level clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed fuzzy map (the map key is the column name).

value.description: Required. The term to match within the allowed edit distance. A string (or scalar value on a non-text column).

fuzziness.description: Optional. Allowed edit distance: an integer or AUTO.

max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms the fuzzy expansion will generate. Default 50.

prefix_length.description: Optional. Number of leading characters left unchanged when fuzzy matching.

transpositions.description: Optional. Whether to count transpositions (ab → ba) as a single edit. Default true.

rewrite.description: Optional. How the multi-term query is rewritten internally.
